name: tuneitverse
description: TuneItVerse - open ECU tuning platform. v3.34.0: in-app bench script runner, catalog bake-in, size-aware report-only checksums, BIN compare histogram.

scripts.build:innosetup: tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && iscc installer\TuneItVerse.iss && node scripts/copy-installer.js
scripts.test: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!p.name||!p.scripts.build) process.exit(1); console.log('ok', p.name, p.version);"
